Your installation

3 selected items; 8 items including shared dependencies.

Use Node 24 and an existing React 19.2 TypeScript app. These commands install the eight matching packages from the checked GitHub release, then run its local CLI. Public npm publication remains separate.

For pnpm 10, the first block uses npm to record the release URLs and checked SDK/schema/type versions in your project's pnpm.overrides, then installs with pnpm. Review these project-local pins alongside your existing overrides.

  1. Install the matching release packages

    npm pkg set \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/core=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-core-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/schemas=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-schemas-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/runtime=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-runtime-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/react=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-react-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/themes=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-themes-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/registry=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-registry-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.mcpcn=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.@mcpcn/server=https://github.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/releases/download/v0.1.0-keyboard.1/mcpcn-server-0.1.0.tgz \
  pnpm.overrides.zod=4.4.3 \

  2. Initialize your configuration

    node node_modules/mcpcn/dist/index.js init --mode=package --style=default --host=standard-mcp --manager=pnpm --components-dir=components/mcpcn --registry=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alvarovillalbaa/mcpcn-ui/d91fe403eb6b3ec07ef9791e47a8655f5ed519f3/registry/items

    Command copied.

  3. Add your selected items

    node node_modules/mcpcn/dist/index.js add approval-card tabs review-before-action

    Command copied.

Step 1 installs the release and its consumer dependencies. The local CLI's generic registry dependency hint is already covered for this pinned release. Steps 2–3 prepare files and configuration; they do not create a framework app or connect a live host.

Mount your provider

components/mcpcn/provider.tsx uses your selected host and theme. Mount its MCPCNProvider around the parts of your app that use MCPCN.

import { MCPCNProvider } from "./components/mcpcn/provider";
import { ApprovalCard } from "@mcpcn/react";
import { Tabs } from "@mcpcn/react";
import { ReviewBeforeAction } from "@mcpcn/react/blocks";
<MCPCNProvider>
  {/* Your selected components and workflow blocks */}
</MCPCNProvider>
Review the generated provider
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AgentAppProvider, OfficialMCPAdapter, type AgentAppAdapter } from "@mcpcn/runtime";
import "@mcpcn/react/styles.css";
import "@mcpcn/themes/default.css";

export function MCPCNProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [adapter, setAdapter] = useState<AgentAppAdapter | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => { setAdapter(new OfficialMCPAdapter()); }, []);
  return <div className="mcpcn" data-mcpcn-theme="default">
    {adapter ? <AgentAppProvider adapter={adapter}>{children}</AgentAppProvider>
      : <p role="status" aria-busy="true">Preparing app connection…</p>}
  </div>;
}
